name: Unicorn Mineral Resources Public Limited Company
summary: Unicorn Mineral Resources Public Limited Company is an Irish-based firm primarily dedicated to the discovery of mineral resources. The company's activities are focused on identifying Irish-type carbonate-hosted deposits rich in copper, lead, zinc, and silver across the mineral-rich Irish midlands. A significant asset for the company is its Kilmallock exploration block, which spans roughly 137 square kilometers in the Limerick Province. This enterprise was founded in 2010 and its headquarters are situated in Dalkey, Ireland.
